objective: Predict measured genotyping quality among publisher-evaluable samples at chromosome-held-out loci; test incremental value of frozen topology.
unit: One GRCh38 locus, equal weight; donor measurements aggregated once before splitting. No sample identity or observed-donor count enters features.
partition: All five manuscript chromosome folds x three original checkpoint seeds x strict/1hop; encoders and probes exclude test/validation chromosomes during encoder training.
encoder: Unchanged frozen manuscript v1 T and NT-v2 50M S; reconstruction-shortcut caveat retained. This does not compare learned versus random weights.
probe: StandardScaler fit only on training chromosomes, Ridge with intercept and direct Cholesky solver, penalty selected by validation MAE; strongest penalty breaks exact ties. No refit on validation, no clipping, no test-directed choice.
inference: Original paired hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap; positive gain means baseline minus full for error metrics and full minus baseline for correlations/R2. Exact fold sign-flip plus BH within metric across endpoints/contexts/contrasts. Five dependent training folds limit confidence; seeds are not independent biological samples.
validity_gates: All 265 loci retained, complete mapped features
Same target/example identities for every model
No missing outcomes treated as failures
At least 10 loci and nonconstant outcome per train/validation/test partition
Saved prediction replay and train/validation-only penalty selection
limitations: Only 265 regions, conditional on available assembled truth; no general callability inference
Predicts quality, does not improve genotyping calls directly
Publisher panel excludes tested donors; original HPRC2 FM graph may contain overlapping donors
Region graph differs from publisher locus graph
Static locus vector cannot predict individual donor-specific quality
No expected positive outcome or architecture selection using this test set
numerical_policy: Double-precision ridge fit and prediction; ill-conditioned solver warnings fail the run. Original float32 feature values are promoted without changing their definitions.
